name: cannavec-science
description: Elite-tier cannabis-science plugin for the working researcher (v0.5 industry-expert-clinical-depth release). Adds five curated registries on top of v0.4 — **clinical pharmacokinetics** (≥ 8 rows: THC inhaled vs oral PK per Huestis 2005 + Wall 1983, CBD food effect per Birnbaum 2019 Epidiolex label, 11-OH-Δ⁹-THC active metabolite, nabiximols oromucosal per Karschner 2011, plasma protein binding + adipose distribution, urine detection window per Huestis 1996), **cannabis use disorder & withdrawal** (≥ 6 rows: DSM-5 CUD framework per Hasin 2013, CUDIT-R per Adamson 2010, Cannabis Withdrawal Scale per Allsop 2011, NESARC-III prevalence per Hasin 2015, twin-study heritability per Verweij 2010, adolescent-onset telescoping per Chen 2009), **cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome** (≥ 4 rows: diagnostic criteria per Sorensen 2017 SR + Allen 2004 + Simonetto 2012, Rome IV framework per Venkatesan 2019, capsaicin acute-phase treatment per Dezieck 2017, post-legalization ED epidemiology per Kim 2018), **eCBome enzyme-inhibitor pharmacology** (≥ 5 rows: PF-04457845 cannabis-withdrawal Phase 2a per D'Souza 2019, PF-04457845 OA-pain Phase 2 per Huggins 2012, BIA 10-2474 Rennes disaster per Kerbrat 2016 WITH explicit off-target-serine-hydrolase disambiguation per van Esbroeck 2017, MAGL inhibitor ABX-1431 per Cisar 2018, dual FAAH/MAGL JZL195 per Long 2009), and **cannabinoid biosynthesis pathway** (≥ 5 rows: OLS + OAC polyketide entry per Taura 2009 + Gagne 2012, CBGAS prenyltransferase per Page 2011, THCA synthase per Sirikantaramas 2004, CBDA synthase per Taura 1996, yeast heterologous expression per Luo 2019 Nature). Adds **Europe PMC** as a twelfth primary-source live-discovery lane (complement to PubMed, indexes European non-MEDLINE-indexed journals). Five commands; sixteen curated science registries with freshness watch and cannabinoid-scoped filtering; seven phytochemistry rigor detectors with (detector, span) deduplication; 16 banned-pattern detectors; safety preflight; span-aware named-cannabinoid resolution; topical-relevance grade aggregation; cannabis-noun → cannabinoid-set expansion for partner-drug matching; endocannabinoidome (eCBome) registry + drug-development inhibitor pharmacology depth; identifier verification across all five Constitution §I shapes (PMID, DOI, NCT, ChEMBL, UniProt); registry inventory subcommand; honest 0-claim classification with rendered hints; retraction enforcement at composition time; live discovery across twelve primary-source databases — PubMed, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubChem, PharmGKB, RCSB PDB, Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, BindingDB, bioRxiv, medRxiv, Europe PMC — with deterministic cross-source synthesis and citation-network forward-pushback analysis; researcher-workflow scaffolders (PICO, sample-size / power calculation, GRADE evidence-profile table, IRB protocol skeleton); regulatory-feasibility advisory (US / EU / Canada / UK); BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography export with inline GRADE annotation; registry-freshness probe. Researcher audience only. Stdlib-only Python ≥ 3.9.
